item.title: Attorney General Ellison wins Public Service Loan Forgiveness lawsuit as Trump Administration drops appeal
item.description:
Publication Date: October 23, 2026

AG Ellison sued in November 2025 to block new federal rule to end loan forgiveness for public servants — including military — for political beliefs and actions Trump Administration disfavors

item.description:

AG Ellison’s Medicaid Fraud Control Unit charged Abdifatah Yusuf in June 2024 for billing Medicaid for services not provided, falsely documented, or overbilled; Yusuf used money to fund lavish lifestyle
